methodologyNotes: Fourteen LED headlight bulb kits were verified against manufacturer product pages where reachable (SEALIGHT, Fahren, BEAMTECH, Auxbeam, Diode Dynamics, Morimoto) and, where a brand's own site returned repeated 404/CAPTCHA/connection errors during this research session (Hikari, GTR Lighting, Philips, and four additional independently-tested models substituted for seed entries Sylvania ZEVO, Philips Ultinon Essential, Cougar Motor H11, LASFIT LC Pro, Torchbeam T2, and OPT7 Fluxbeam, whose own sites could not be reached live), against BulbFacts.com's independent bench-test reviews (real, live, product-specific pages used as the source of record instead), with two further seed-list corrections documented per-product in provenance: Diode Dynamics SL1 is confirmed discontinued/clearance and never offered in H11 (H9/9005/9006 only), and Morimoto's current site lists only the "2Stroke 4.0" successor (used in place of seed "2Stroke 3.0"), and with every unconfirmed numeric figure (e.g. wattage where a source states only current draw, price where only a street-price range was found) left null rather than estimated, all accessed 2026-08-12.
